items.title: PHP Releases New Windows Build Security Updates to Fix Critical HTTP2Shell Vulnerability
items.description:
The PHP team has released updated Windows builds to fix a serious flaw known as HTTP2Shell. The new packages are PHP 8.5.12-1, 8.4.27-1, 8.3.36-1, and 8.2.35-1, and PHP announced them on October 26, 2026. Each build now includes Brotli 1.2.1, which fixes CVE-2026-111497. Windows users who run PHP should install these packages without delay. The […]
